metadata.label: Absolute Value abs(x)
metadata.description: Returns the non-negative magnitude |x| of a real scalar expression.
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL: A Modeling Language for Mathematical Programming (Table A-1) / IEEE 754

metadata.label: Ceiling Function ceil(x)
metadata.description: Returns the smallest integer value greater than or equal to x.
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Table A-1) / IEEE 754

metadata.label: Floor Function floor(x)
metadata.description: Returns the largest integer value less than or equal to x.
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Table A-1) / IEEE 754

metadata.label: Decimal Rounding round(x, n)
metadata.description: Rounds x to n decimal places (negative n rounds to powers of 10).
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Section 7.4, Table A-1)

parameters.description: Number of decimal places n (negative rounds left of decimal)

metadata.label: Decimal Truncation trunc(x, n)
metadata.description: Truncates x toward zero to n decimal places.
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Section 7.4, Table A-1)

parameters.description: Number of decimal places n to retain

metadata.label: Floored Modulo mod(a, b)
metadata.description: Computes the AMPL remainder a - b * floor(a / b) for nonzero divisor b.
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Section 7.2, Arithmetic Operators)

parameters.description: Default divisor b when second input is omitted

metadata.label: Integer Quotient div(a, b)
metadata.description: Computes the truncated integer quotient trunc(a / b) for nonzero divisor b.
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Section 7.2, Arithmetic Operators)

parameters.description: Default divisor b when second input is omitted

metadata.label: Minimum min(a, b)
metadata.description: Returns the minimum of two or more real arguments.
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Table A-1) / IEEE 754

metadata.label: Maximum max(a, b)
metadata.description: Returns the maximum of two or more real arguments.
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Table A-1) / IEEE 754

metadata.label: Exponential exp(x)
metadata.description: Computes the natural exponential e^x with derivative e^x.
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Table A-1) / IEEE 754

metadata.label: Natural Logarithm log(x)
metadata.description: Computes the natural logarithm ln(x) for x > 0 with derivative 1/x.
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Table A-1) / IEEE 754

metadata.label: Base-10 Logarithm log10(x)
metadata.description: Computes the common logarithm log10(x) for x > 0.
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Table A-1) / IEEE 754

metadata.label: Square Root sqrt(x)
metadata.description: Computes the principal square root sqrt(x) for x >= 0.
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Table A-1) / IEEE 754

metadata.label: Sine sin(x)
metadata.description: Computes the trigonometric sine of angle x (radians).
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Table A-1) / IEEE 754

metadata.label: Cosine cos(x)
metadata.description: Computes the trigonometric cosine of angle x (radians).
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Table A-1) / IEEE 754

metadata.label: Tangent tan(x)
metadata.description: Computes the trigonometric tangent of angle x (radians).
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Table A-1) / IEEE 754

metadata.label: Two-Argument Arctangent atan2(y, x)
metadata.description: Computes the principal value of arctan(y / x) in (-pi, pi] using quadrant signs.
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Table A-1) / IEEE 754

metadata.label: Hyperbolic Sine sinh(x)
metadata.description: Computes the hyperbolic sine (e^x - e^-x) / 2.
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Table A-1) / Abramowitz & Stegun 4.5

metadata.label: Hyperbolic Cosine cosh(x)
metadata.description: Computes the hyperbolic cosine (e^x + e^-x) / 2.
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Table A-1) / Abramowitz & Stegun 4.5

metadata.label: Hyperbolic Tangent tanh(x)
metadata.description: Computes the hyperbolic tangent sinh(x) / cosh(x).
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Table A-1) / Abramowitz & Stegun 4.5

metadata.label: Normal Distribution Normal(mu, sigma)
metadata.description: Evaluates Normal(mu, sigma) probability density (PDF) and cumulative distribution (CDF) via A&S 7.1.26 erf.
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Table A-3) / Abramowitz & Stegun 7.1.26 & 26.2

metadata.label: Uniform Distribution Uniform(a, b)
metadata.description: Evaluates continuous Uniform(a, b) density and CDF on [a, b].
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Table A-3) / Abramowitz & Stegun 26.1

metadata.label: Exponential Distribution Exponential(lambda)
metadata.description: Evaluates Exponential(lambda) PDF lambda*exp(-lambda*x) and CDF 1 - exp(-lambda*x) for x >= 0.
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Table A-3) / Abramowitz & Stegun 26.1

metadata.label: Poisson Distribution Poisson(lambda)
metadata.description: Evaluates discrete Poisson(lambda) PMF (lambda^k * e^-lambda) / k! using log-gamma.
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Table A-3) / Abramowitz & Stegun 26.1.22

metadata.label: Beta Distribution Beta(alpha, beta)
metadata.description: Evaluates continuous Beta(alpha, beta) probability density on (0, 1) via Lanczos log-gamma.
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Table A-3) / Abramowitz & Stegun 6.2 & 26.1.33

metadata.label: Gamma Function Gamma(x)
metadata.description: Evaluates the Euler Gamma function Gamma(x) and ln|Gamma(x)| via 9-term Lanczos approximation with reflection.
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Table A-3) / Abramowitz & Stegun 6.1 / Lanczos (1964)

metadata.label: Continuous Piecewise-Linear <<bp1, bp2; s0, s1, s2>> x
metadata.description: Evaluates AMPL continuous piecewise-linear expression <<bp1, bp2; s0, s1, s2>> x anchored at f(0) = 0 with active slope output.
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Chapter 17, Piecewise-Linear Programs)

metadata.label: Significant-Digit Rounding precision(x, n)
metadata.description: Rounds x to n significant decimal digits for presolve and display normalization.
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Section 7.4, Table A-1)

parameters.description: Number of significant decimal digits n (>= 1)

metadata.label: Positive Excess less(a, b) = max(a - b, 0)
metadata.description: Computes the AMPL piecewise-linear hinge function less(a, b) = max(a - b, 0).
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Table A-1, Section 7.4)

parameters.description: Default threshold b when second input is omitted

metadata.label: Indexed Summation sum{i in S} x[i]
metadata.description: Aggregates the sum of indexed numeric expressions over an AMPL indexing set.
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Section 7.3, Iterated Operators)

metadata.label: Indexed Product prod{i in S} x[i]
metadata.description: Aggregates the product of indexed numeric expressions over an AMPL indexing set.
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Section 7.3, Iterated Operators)

metadata.label: Set Cardinality card(S)
metadata.description: Returns the non-negative integer cardinality |S| of a finite AMPL set.
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Section 5.6, Built-in Set Functions)

metadata.label: Ordered Set Position ord(e, S)
metadata.description: Returns the 1-based ordinal index of member e within an ordered AMPL set S.
metadata.provenance: Fourer, Gay & Kernighan, AMPL Book (Section 5.6, Ordered Sets)
